messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: PD#PDR12345 — Inflight queue length > 5k on inference-cell-eu-west-1. Autoscaler reconciliation failing; recent scale attempts returned 429s and node provisioning timeouts. Severity: SEV2 :rotating_light:
oncall-eric: acked — I'll take first look. Can someone post the current queue metric and recent scale events?
maya-prod: queue_length: 5,210, drain_rate: 30 req/s (target needed ~200 req/s). 5xx spike at proxy tier starting ~5m ago. not all requests are serviceable.
sre-lee: seeing repeated errors from scale-controller: `reconcile failed: insufficient capacity in spot pool` and `kubeapi: rate limit exceeded`. Logs attached snippet: ```ERROR scale-controller: failed to create nodegroup: capacityGroup=spot-eu-west-1: insufficient resources```
ops-sam: PD escalation shows two automated retries to scale + fallback to on-demand but kube api 429s blocked node create. Attempting manual ephemeral spinup in another AZ.
oncall-eric: OK. Manual mitigation plan: 1) increase on-demand fallback to 30 for this cell, 2) divert ~30% of new traffic to inference-cell-eu-central-1, 3) flush small prefix cache to improve drain rate. I'm going to run scale command now.
cara: I can change routing in the proxy; prepping canary shift to eu-central. Will hold at 25% then 50% if healthy.
oncall-eric: running: `kubectl scale deploy inference-cell --replicas=30 -n inference-prod` — response: `scaled` but controller still failing to provision new nodes (still 429).
sre-lee: submitted support ticket with cloud vendor for spot pool shortage and asked to prioritize fallback. Meanwhile try increasing node provisioning concurrency limiter. Patch queued: `controller.maxProvisionConcurrency=10 -> 20`
jules: I've triggered proxy routing change: shifting 25% to eu-central now. Monitoring latency & 5xx.
maya-prod: after shift 25%: overall 5xx dropped ~18%, queue down to 4,600. Drain_rate up to 60 req/s. Good sign.
oncall-eric: good. ops-sam, follow-up actions: keep on-demand fallback at 30 until vendor confirms spot replenishment; coordinate with platform to relax API rate limits for scale-controller for next 30m. Also open RITM for increasing reserved capacity if this repeats.
ops-sam: noted. Filed internal action item: RITM-8893. Vendor replied acknowledging shortage, ETA 45m for capacity; elevated to urgent.
sre-lee: added temporary policy: prefer on-demand, scale minReplicas=10 for next 2 hours. Will revert after stabilization.
oncall-eric: TL;DR: acked PD, manual scale + routing shift reduced customer impact; tracking vendor ETA; followups: RITM-8893, revert policy ticket ENGOPS-2412, postmortem if root cause is provider capacity. Handing off to on-call rotation 2 — @jules take next 30m watch, I'll remain available.
jules: taking watch. will post updates. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident updated — acknowledged by oncall-eric, responders: ops-sam, maya-prod, sre-lee, jules.
